name: Noir Detective
author: mattboy112
description: Hard-boiled narration for every jump, kill and contract. The rain is optional.

lines.arm_on: Armistice. The kind of quiet that makes you nervous.
lines.arm_off: Out of armistice. The city doesn't sleep, and neither do the guns.
lines.juris_ungoverned: No law out here. Just people and their bad decisions.
lines.qt_arrived: We made it. The question was always what was waiting.
lines.kill_first: The {victim} went down. They usually do.
lines.kill_n: Another {victim} down. That's {n}. Nobody's counting but me.
lines.ship_lost: The {victim} was a good ship. Good ships don't last.
lines.contract_accepted: A new case landed on my desk. {name}
lines.greeting: Co-pilot's on. Coffee's black. Let's go to work.
lines.ack.lights_off: Lights off. Some things look better in the dark.
